title: Best Malware Analysis Platforms for Security Teams
content_md: Malware can hide inside legitimate-looking files, exploit vulnerabilities, execute malicious scripts, or remain dormant until specific conditions are met. For security teams, identifying a suspicious file is only the beginning. They also need to understand what it does, how dangerous it is, which systems it may affect, and what action to take. A malware analysis platform helps answer these questions by examining suspicious files, URLs, scripts, and other potentially malicious artifacts. Using static and dynamic analysis, sandboxing, behavioral monitoring, and threat intelligence, these platforms help analysts understand malware without exposing production environments to unnecessary risk. Why Do Security Teams Use Malware Analysis Platforms? Security teams handle large volumes of suspicious files and alerts. Investigating every artifact manually can consume analyst time and delay responses to genuine threats. Malware analysis platforms provide a controlled and repeatable way to investigate suspicious content.
